Exhaustive native check over ALL report and question functions for 16 small (h,v,s) triples including empty and degenerate ones (including h=0, v=2, s=0 where the empty question factors through the empty image but has no extension): factoring equals fiber constancy pair by pair, factoring counts equal sum_k C(v,k) k! S2(h,k) s^k (recomputed independently of the enumeration, with the fiber-constant count recomputed separately from set partitions), every factoring pair has exactly one factor on the image and s^(v-k) extensions. report:
# PG-HISTORY-REPORT-CRITERION

The source declares the criterion for arbitrary types (Paper.lean history_report_criterion, history_factor_unique) and its variants (ProposalAdmissionBridge, Descent with surjectivity, Paper001 descent). The source statement is general and correct; its mpr direction uses Classical.choose exactly to select a representative of each fiber. This node re-derives the criterion, isolates the selector as a hypothesis (axiom-free) and records the kernel axiom report of each direction, adds the off-image non-uniqueness and surjective uniqueness boundary, and checks all report/question function pairs on 16 finite triples. The constructive listed version is the sibling node 166. The Rust FactorizationCertificate (code/rust/src/category_theory/finite_report_query.rs line 151, flagged for re-review after upstream restoration) was re-read: on enumerated carriers it stores the realized image, a decoder and an explicit representative map (the selector as data) next to a Collision alternative, a finite certificate of the same dichotomy, not the general theorem.

Supported: For arbitrary types H, V, S (kernel-checked, lean4/HistoryReport.lean): factoring through the report image implies constancy on report fibers without any axiom; constancy on fibers implies factoring when a selector of a history in every nonempty fiber is supplied as a hypothesis, again without any axiom, and for an arbitrary report the selector is obtained from Classical.choice (the kernel reports Classical.choice for selector_exists and for the unconditional criterion, Quot.sound for uniqueness on the image via funext); the factor is unique on the image; two histories with one report and two answers refute factoring; off the image the extension to all reports is not unique under the hypotheses of off_image_not_unique: DecidableEq of the report type, an off-image point v0, an extension f, and a value s different from f v0 (so at least two answers); for a surjective report the extension is unique. Exhaustive native check over ALL report and question functions for 16 small (h,v,s) triples including empty and degenerate ones (including h=0, v=2, s=0 where the empty question factors through the empty image but has no extension): factoring equals fiber constancy pair by pair, factoring counts equal sum_k C(v,k) k! S2(h,k) s^k (recomputed independently of the enumeration, with the fiber-constant count recomputed separately from set partitions), every factoring pair has exactly one factor on the image and s^(v-k) extensions. The finite native check is combinatorial corroboration only and is insensitive to the choice question, since choice is provable on finite types.

Remaining: Necessity of a selector or of Classical.choice for the direction constancy => factoring (this node proves no independence or unprovability result; the selector is a hypothesis, not a construction); the constructive listed-history reconstruction (node PG-PREGEN-CONSTRUCTIVE-SUMMARY); any structure on H, V or S, probability, measurement or physical interpretation of reports.
construction: Exhaustive enumeration of all reports H -> V and questions H -> S with direct search for factors on the image and extensions to V; Lean proves the general criterion and records axiom bills.
